why: n8nApiWrapper.listWorkflows() (n8nApiWrapper.ts:246-258) has three console.error debug prints. Unlike every other debug line in this codebase -- e.g. environmentManager.ts:51-55 explicitly gates its own API-key log line behind `if (process.env.DEBUG === 'true')` -- these three lines are unconditional, so `console.error('[DEBUG] Headers:', api.defaults.headers)` writes the live n8n API key to stderr on every single list_workflows call, in every deployment, not just when DEBUG=true. This is a real secret-in-log exposure (CWE-532/CWE-200), but the leak does not hinge on any caller-supplied argument value -- calling the tool at all with any arguments (even {}) triggers it -- so it fails Tier-A criterion 1 (argument-driven) even though the mechanism itself is unambiguous and unguarded; filing as Tier B.
